The '''small bent rod''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that was in the possession of some [[Black Ajah]] sisters; it was recovered by them from [[Moghedien]]'s rooms in [[Samara]] after the [[Forsaken]] was captured by [[Nynaeve]].

It can be assumed that now this item is in possession of [[Elayne]], since this Black sisters were captured in [[Caemlyn]].

==Appearance==
The rod is about an inch in diameter and slightly bent.

==Use==
Using the ''ter'angreal'', a woman can embrace ''saidar'' without other channelers able to feel it.{{ref/book|11|31}}
